slice: fixed-host P0 single-user chat-memory probe: startup embedding verification passed; the write phase reached the reply/draft stage but generation failed without a verified draft; no retry
purpose: P0 bounded real single-user chat-memory validation under a frozen plan: write phase (save synthetic fact + real local embedding index + one local reply <=256 tokens), ordered reload with automatic startup embedding verification, then recall phase. Two host attempts were needed because the first failed pre-model on INVALID_INDEX_OBSERVATION; the fix was committed (ff5ea11), then one further write attempt was made. The second attempt reached draft generation but produced no verified reply. Per the frozen no-retry rule the recall phase was not executed.

attempts.detail: the probe indexed the synthetic fact and the backend became embeddingVerified, but the published memory manifest still advertised exact_read only, so the reply ReadView rejected the index observation. Fixed in ff5ea11 with the trusted onIndexed publish hook.

attempts.result: reached reply draft generation; no current verified draft
attempts.generationModelCalls: attempted (usage null/unknown; no verified assistant draft)
attempts.detail: the memory fact was written, indexed (real embedding; indexWatermark 6) and the reply ReadView observed two controlled memory sources and created a draft; the replyer session was cancelled without a verified draft. This is a generation/provider failure on the same upstream path that returned empty streams in the v6 core attempt; automatic retry is forbidden and the recall phase was not run.

startupEmbeddingVerification.note: after the second ordered reload the process performed exactly one fixed local embedding query and published semantic_search; this closes the reload-readiness gap but is not a chat-memory recall proof.

memory.note: two synthetic chat-memory-probe facts are retained active (cccbba76 and d855739f); recall withdrawal was not reached because the write phase did not pass. They are disclosed residual synthetic data.

milestones: Startup automatic embedding verification passed on the fixed host: exactly one local embedding call, semanticPublished=true, manifest memory capabilities exact_read+semantic_search with the profile fingerprint (after a reload that previously fell back to exact_read).

The chat-memory write phase reached the reply stage with two controlled memory sources in the ReadView and a draft, proving the memory->ReadView wiring; however no current verified assistant draft was produced, so the P0 chat-memory round-trip is NOT passed.
blockers: Generation/reply failure: the replyer session was cancelled with reply status unknown and usage null; the same upstream empty/failed-stream class observed in the v6 core attempt. No retry was made; a further attempt is a new explicit owner decision.
Live emotion behavior and subjective experience remain unverified; workspace Runtime/TaskRunner execution remains unverified (offline tests only).
limitations: No recall phase was executed, so restart recall, marker containment and same-session evidence are NOT verified.
The two synthetic retained facts are residual data and are disclosed; no cleanup was attempted during the failed write.
The host evidence is limited to a failed generation attempt plus the startup embedding-verification success; it does not prove single-user multi-turn chat memory.
